name: Surrey Metal Detecting Day Event
description:
Brand new land for Surrey Metal Detecting Club!
These fields have previously been used for several festivals, making them particularly interesting for anyone who enjoys coin shooting and finding modern jewellery.
During our recent recce, we discovered plenty of targets, including modern coins, jewellery and a few older finds. Although there is always the possibility of uncovering something historic, these fields are expected to be more suited to modern coin and jewellery hunting.
We have two fields available to explore, so there should be plenty of opportunities to get your detectors swinging!
Vip Member £15, Non Vip Member £20
LIMITED SPACES
